spellbook.finance/limitations: The promotion is store-wide and affects eligible items across all of the caller's workspaces connected to this eBay account; workspaceId validates owner access only. This setting requires agent_marketplace_publish authorization.
The returned active status is provider promotion state, not proof of a buyer checkout total or improved profit.

annotations.title: Set a store-wide eBay order discount

description: Set a store-wide eBay order discount based on a seller-selected minimum quantity and percentage. Call spellbook_ebay_order_discount_get first; only one tracked order-discount promotion is supported, so this may replace the existing one.

workspaceId.description: Workspace the caller owns; used for delegated authorization. Required.

name: spellbook_ebay_order_discount_set
